statement: CVE-2026-55040, the Microsoft SharePoint JWT authentication-bypass flaw under active exploitation via public proof-of-concept code as of 13 Aug 2026, will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-25.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog at cisa.gov lists CVE-2026-55040 with a dateAdded date between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-25, checked as of 2026-08-27.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-55040 has not been added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded date in the stated window, as of 2026-08-27.

statement: A specific victim organization of the City-Forum data-theft campaign against Salesforce Experience Cloud and ServiceNow portals will be publicly named, by the victim, by Reco, or by another named security-research firm, between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-22.
resolution: A named security vendor, the victim itself, or a wire service publicly identifies a specific organization as a confirmed City-Forum campaign victim, in reporting dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-24.
failure_condition: No specific organization has been publicly named as a City-Forum campaign victim, as of 2026-09-24.

statement: Between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, Ukrainian forces will conduct a further confirmed drone or missile strike on Russian Black Sea export or naval infrastructure, at a port such as Novorossiysk, Tuapse, or another Black Sea facility.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, or the Institute for the Study of War daily assessment report a Ukrainian strike on Russian Black Sea port or naval infrastructure between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, checked by 2026-09-01.
failure_condition: Ukrainian forces do not conduct an independently confirmed strike on Russian Black Sea port or naval infrastructure between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28.

statement: Between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, a commercial or naval vessel in or near the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman will be attacked, fired upon, boarded, or disabled by Iranian or Iran-aligned forces, or struck by US or CENTCOM forces in the same theatre.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, or a US Navy Fifth Fleet or CENTCOM statement report a vessel attack, seizure, or strike in the Hormuz-Oman theatre between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, checked by 2026-09-01.
failure_condition: No vessel attack, seizure, boarding, or strike in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman theatre is independently confirmed between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28.

statement: WTI crude oil, the NYMEX front-month futures contract, will settle at or above 85.00 USD per barrel at the close of trading on 2026-09-15.
resolution: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price for 2026-09-15, as published by CME Group, the EIA, or a financial data provider, is 85.00 USD per barrel or higher.
failure_condition: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price on 2026-09-15 is below 85.00 USD per barrel.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite index will close below 26000.00 on 2026-09-15, a decline of at least 3 percent from its 13 Aug 2026 close of 26805.65.
resolution: The Nasdaq Composite closing value for 2026-09-15, as published by Nasdaq or a financial data provider, is below 26000.00.
failure_condition: The Nasdaq Composite closing value on 2026-09-15 is 26000.00 or higher.

statement: Nigel Farage of Reform UK will be declared the winner of the 2026 Clacton parliamentary by-election held on 2026-08-13.
resolution: The declared result for the Clacton by-election, as reported by the BBC, the Press Association, or the UK returning officer, names Nigel Farage as the winning candidate, checked by 2026-08-20.
failure_condition: The declared Clacton by-election winner is not Nigel Farage, or no result has been declared, as of 2026-08-20.

statement: Hakainde Hichilema will be declared the outright winner of Zambia's 13 August 2026 presidential election in the first round, with more than 50 percent of valid votes, avoiding a runoff.
resolution: The Electoral Commission of Zambia declares Hichilema the first-round winner with over 50 percent of valid votes, as reported by Reuters, AP, or the ECZ, checked by 2026-08-27.
failure_condition: Hichilema is not declared a first-round winner with more than 50 percent of valid votes, as of 2026-08-27.

statement: The confirmed death toll from the 10 August 2026 magnitude-7.4 Colombia earthquake, epicenter San Jose del Palmar, will be reported at 300 or more, as of 2026-08-25.
resolution: A Colombian government source, UNGRD, or a wire service such as AP, Reuters, or AFP reports a confirmed death toll of 300 or more from the Colombia earthquake, as of 2026-08-25, checked by 2026-08-27.
failure_condition: The confirmed death toll from the Colombia earthquake remains below 300, as of 2026-08-25.

statement: Gomes Clesio Tavares, the Cameroonian national wanted under a Rome arrest warrant as an intermediary in the October 2025 bomb attack on journalist Sigfrido Ranucci, will be reported captured or taken into custody by any law-enforcement authority between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-13.
resolution: An Italian outlet such as ANSA, Corriere della Sera, or La Repubblica, or an international wire service such as AFP or Reuters, reports Gomes Clesio Tavares arrested, detained, or in custody, in reporting dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: Gomes Clesio Tavares remains at large, not arrested or in custody, as of 2026-10-15.
